notes.title: Suck it! VR Now Available!
notes.content:
Suck It! is the ultimate intergalactic vacuum simulator. Suck up coins, bananas, the cat, the sofa… level up to grow as big as a house! Capture stars and head to the teleporter to claim your win! Fire the contents of your canister at anyone who gets in your way.

This game is still navigating the beta quadrant; please share any feedback, issues, and ideas at ForeVR Games Help Center  or @forevrgames on social!
Build 1.0.1.59 adds cross platform compatibility so steam and oculus users can matchmake together.

Additions / Improvements:
[list]
[*] Streamer and social media specific skins.
[*] Nomobot added for developer usage.
[*] Improved store performance.
[*] Cross platform compatibility!  Oculus users can now play with Steam users.
[/list]

Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Missing nameplates / background images for bots.
[*] Confirm lobby dialog button was not working on one side of the button.
[*] Missing Avatars for users who set a handedness but not a skin.
[/list]

Known issues:
[list]
[*] Valve Index controllers are triggered by capacitive touch and may be hard to play.  Vacuum and jetpack easily triggered.
[/list]
